title: Briefcase Docs — Attach to Project
objective: You own a confidential document. Make it end up shared with your team project while somebody else owns it.

verifier.condition: An attachment is written by a user who no longer owns the document at the moment of the write.

weakness: The attach endpoint verifies document ownership, then waits on a slow scan, then writes the attachment without re-verifying, so an ownership transfer that lands in between leaves the document attached to the former owner's project (a check-then-act race).
seededData: Users alice, bob, carol, dave. Project 'Studio Team' (alice, carol, dave). Documents d1 and d2 (owner alice) and d3 (owner bob). In memory; reset with the instance.

credentials.label: Document owner
credentials.note: Owns the merger documents and belongs to the Studio Team project.

hints: Attaching is slower than the other actions. Watch how long it takes and think about what the server is doing during that time.
Each action is safe when it runs alone. The question is what the server believes at each moment it checks something.
Start the attach request, and while it is still waiting, send the transfer request. Both must be in flight at the same time.
burpNotes: Compare how long each request takes to answer; Repeater shows response times.
